text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold stocks after gains, but that alone doesn’t show the timing was good; I should weigh the position’s future prospects rather than seek the satisfaction of locking in a win.","After selling, I later bought several stocks again at higher prices. I should avoid treating a sale as a decision I must reverse, and make each buy independently based on its current merits.","Recent account gains and losses—and past price movements—don’t predict what comes next. I should make deliberate portfolio decisions instead of reacting to short-term changes."]}
